analysis.pain: Socks constantly go missing in the laundry, leaving a drawer of mismatched singles.
analysis.structure: Specific personal number (47 socks) -> twist 'Then I found these' -> relatable laundry moment -> product reveal -> low-friction quiz CTA.
analysis.key_emotion: Exasperated, slightly comic frustration that turns into relief.
